literature_logbeta_source: Wen et al. (2024), ACS Earth and Space Chemistry, 10.1021/acsearthspacechem.4c00009, Table 1
literature_reaction: Ln3+ + Cit3- + HCit2- = Ln(Cit)(HCit)2-; log beta standard-state
model_assumptions: Only Ln(Cit)(HCit)2- among the many aqueous Ln-citrate complexes
PHREEQC citrate-free nonfree Ln fraction is a fixed effective odds calibrated at each pH/salt
Davies I approximated by NaNO3 background: not self-consistent, limited accuracy for trivalent ions
Metal concentration units are approximated as mol/L from mmol/kg water in dilute conditions
Only free Ln3+ permeates in illustrative transport; no membrane charge or multi-ion transport
No fitted surface citrate binding, no DFT, no MD or measured transport
+/-0.5 logbeta are chosen sensitivity scenarios, NOT statistical uncertainty estimates
